The walk has a narrower silhouette, mask/head variation and a smaller embedded axe than the accepted idle. These identity differences remain explicit provisional-integration caveats.

The separately generated source images use measured Pixel Respecter pitches12,12,11,12. A reviewed native_scale_group retains the contact2 reconstruction exactly; all canvases80x96/pivot40,96, visible heights55/56/54/55, and no post-reconstruction resizing.

promotion_review.scope: Root accepted the exact four guided SE frames after production pursuit review. All four actual phase crops were viewed at native 1x; normal 3440 live entry and F3 were also reviewed. Supported native suites/all 72 scenarios, browser 32/32, importer 10/10 and equipment checks were reported passing by root.
